material.acceptance_criteria: A CI run starts with --mod and a directory --data, edits a .star file, and sees the mod's view of the image change without a restart.
material.description: The mod host loads the startup image only, so --mod with a directory --data fails at startup, and a data reload does not reach the mod host.
material.resolution: The mod host follows data reloads: a directory --data builds the mod image through build_image, and a .star edit rebuilds it and swaps it in between ticks, logging ev=mod_image_reloaded. A failed rebuild logs ev=mod_image_reload_failed and keeps the old image. CI shows the mod-visible value change from 24 to 31 with no restart.
material.subject: Mod host follows a data directory reload
